description.value: Circle K is a convenience store chain location on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, a dense urban neighbourhood popular with cyclists riding the nearby seawall. This location offers grab-and-go food, hot roller grill items, fresh coffee, and ATM access, making it a convenient urban resupply stop. It is wheelchair accessible per OSM.
